It publishes hundreds of thousands of functionally useless or near-empty packages, which strains registry infrastructure, risks denial-of-service (DoS) conditions, and pollutes the open source ecosystem. The packages are interlinked via dependencies, amplifying the impact and complicating removal, and may serve as a smokescreen for more targeted malicious activity or to exploit blockchain-based reward systems.
